_disclaimer: HYPOTHETICAL, illustrative portfolio assumptions chosen by the author for Milestone 4 of this learning project. These numbers do NOT represent Vesta Corporation, the IEEE-CIS competition, any real bank, any real payments company, or any employer. They exist only so the decision-cost framework in src/models/cost_model.py has concrete numbers to compute with. Change them freely; nothing in this repository treats them as real financial figures.
_review_model_note: review_capacity_frac/review_fraud_catch_rate/review_false_positive_rate were added in a Milestone 4 methodology correction, replacing an initial assumption that manual review had unlimited capacity and was a perfect fraud backstop. All three remain illustrative and configurable, not measured from any real review operation.
